value.label: Main Floor Phase
value.description: Tank holds Pinnacle still and faced away while group handles Staff Attack, Streak, Charging Up, Centurion Steam, meteors, and cleave.

evidence.source_name: Xynode Halls of Fabrication Trial Guide

value.label: Shade Sequence Added
value.description: Pinnacle splits into four shades around the tank; the solid shade attacks in sequence and must be faced and blocked correctly.

evidence.source_name: Xynode Halls of Fabrication Trial Guide

value.label: Charging Centurion Added
value.description: Charging Centurions begin spawning in addition to existing mechanics; kill them quickly or have the off-tank kite their spin away from group.

evidence.source_name: Xynode Halls of Fabrication Trial Guide

value.label: Upper Platform Cycle
value.description: Four players take outer-platform synergies upstairs, kill four spheres using the lightning-beam shield-break mechanic, then activate four consoles nearly together and return.

evidence.source_name: Xynode Halls of Fabrication Trial Guide
